thread.title: Water service outage scheduled for East Maui on May 26 and 27

author: U. N. Kim
title: Water service outage scheduled for East Maui on May 26 and 27
text:
The County of Maui announced on May 20 a scheduled water service outage in the area from St. Peter Church Road to Koali in East Maui. The outage is planned to occur from approximately 9 a.m. to 3 p.m. on Tuesday, May 26 and Wednesday, May 27, or until maintenance work is completed.
According to the announcement, the temporary interruption will affect about 73 residences and 15 standpipes in the impacted area.
Residents are advised that water service may not be restored until after maintenance work concludes. Those who experience a water emergency or require guidance following restoration are encouraged to visit the County’s helpline at https://www.mauicounty.gov/3004/247-Water-Service-Helpline.
No additional background information was provided regarding the nature of the maintenance work or potential long-term impacts.
The County said it will provide updates if there are changes to the schedule or further instructions for affected residents.
